brand.name: Harbourline Homes
brand.descriptor: A directory of homes to rent and buy along the Cornish coast, listed by local agents.

text.heading: Find a place by the sea, from people who know the street
text.body: Every listing comes from a local agent who has walked through the door. Search by town, then filter by bedrooms, budget and how far you want to be from the water.
